title: Spins
title.tagline: A game of five wheels, played in taverns.
title.record: Your record at the tavern: {wins} won of {played} played.

notice.save_refused: The saved record could not be read, so this visit starts fresh.
notice.oak_locked: Oak wheels are won by beating the tavern's champion.
notice.oak_won: You won a set of oak wheels. Choose them when you seat your Legends.

rules.heading: How to play
rules.1: You and your opponent each start with {health} health. Bring theirs to none.
rules.2: Each turn you have {spins} spins of your {wheels} wheels. The first spin turns them all.
rules.3: Between spins, lock the wheels you want to keep. You can unlock them again before the next spin.
rules.4: Your opponent's wheels stay covered until the turn ends. Then both sides show.
rules.5: Red symbols are squares, blue are diamonds, Barricade symbols are hammers. A panel can show one or two.
rules.6: {oak}oak+: {oak} symbols of a kind make one segment, and each symbol after that makes one more.
rules.7: Barricade segments stack up to {barricade.max} and block damage one for one. Energy segments fill your Legends' bars.
rules.8: A full bar acts at the end of the turn: Knight {knight.cost}, Wizard {wizard.cost}, Bowman {bowman.cost} segments.
rules.9: Gilded panels give XP. At {xp.max} XP a Legend evolves from Bronze to Silver to Gold and hits harder.

knight.name: Knight
knight.does: Strikes once for {knight.damage}. A Barricade takes the whole blow.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.does: Two bolts of {wizard.damage}. The second flies over any Barricade.

bowman.name: Bowman
bowman.does: An arrow for {bowman.damage} at height {bowman.height}: over a lower Barricade, or {bowman.chip} off a taller one.

legends.heading: Seat your Legends
legends.help: The first Legend you seat sits Red, on your left. The second sits Blue, on your right.

tavern.name: The Wagon Wheel
tavern.help: Three players are looking for a game. Halvard is the tavern's champion.

wenna.name: Old Wenna
wenna.about: Locks whatever she likes the look of.

tobble.name: Brother Tobble
tobble.about: Chases his fullest bar and stops when it is full.

halvard.name: Halvard
halvard.about: Counts your Barricade and weighs every lock.

over.turn: The match ended on turn {turn} against {name}.

hit.over: It flies over the Barricade and hits {foe} for {amount}.
hit.none: There is no health left to hit.

over.draw: Both fall on the same turn: a draw.

prompt.lock: Lock the wheels to keep, then spin. {left} left, or end the turn.
prompt.all_locked: Every wheel is locked. End the turn.
